primary_source_support.verified_fact: GNU ld documents that hash-style build IDs are the same for identical output files. Therefore a build ID is useful linked-artifact identity but is not, by itself, a unique identity for a particular filesystem instance or admitted semantic lineage.

grf.hypothesis: Binary content hash plus ELF/build fingerprint can uniquely distinguish the admitted Frank artifact from a byte-identical sibling copy.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: Two distinct filesystem instances can be byte-identical and carry the same ELF Build ID while remaining different concrete objects.
grf.falsifier: Create two byte-identical ELF sibling copies, compare SHA-256 and GNU Build ID, then compare filesystem object identity.

unusual_experiment.name: BYTE_IDENTICAL_ELF_SIBLING_IDENTITY_SPLIT
unusual_experiment.method: Copy /bin/true twice into a temporary directory; compare SHA-256, GNU Build ID, byte equality, device and inode; remove the directory afterwards.
limitations: The experiment used /bin/true, not the Frank binary.
It proves a general identity-mechanism insufficiency for byte-identical siblings, not a production bypass in Frank.
Device/inode distinguishes these live filesystem objects but is not proposed as a sufficient semantic-lineage anchor across move, redeploy or restart.
No Frank process, accepted Hostinger service, persistent state, database, effect authority or Harness was modified.

collapse.claim: Equal content hash and equal GNU Build ID imply the same concrete artifact instance.
Content hash and build fingerprint remain useful evidence for build provenance and tamper detection.
Filesystem inode alone should become Frank semantic identity.
collapse.reason: Instance-local filesystem identity does not by itself encode admitted persistent semantic lineage or required restart/move continuity.

collapse.claim: F-V01-01 or Frank v0.1 is complete.

architecture_delta.new_invariant: Build/content identity must not be promoted into unique runtime semantic-lineage identity. Acceptance must discriminate a byte-identical sibling/transplanted artifact while still preserving the explicitly allowed restart/move continuity of the admitted self.root lineage.
architecture_delta.rollback: No product code changed; remove or supersede this research interpretation only if a stronger current contract explicitly defines sibling copies as the same admitted lineage and provides accepted-host evidence for that semantics.

In matched controls, exercise an allowed clean restart and an allowed move/rename. next_falsifier.do_not_substitute: content hash, ELF Build ID, pathname, inode, self-hosted CI or synthetic-only evidence for accepted Hostinger semantic-lineage acceptance
